{{Quote|Don't play coy with me. You'll discover that I have neither the time nor the temperament for it.|Commissioner Dragomir Chlorus, to Sadiki Blirr|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>}}
[[Dragomir Chlorus]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Commissioner (Galactic Gaming Commission)|Commissioner]] for the [[Galactic Gaming Commission]] in the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was responsible for monitoring the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights between prisoners at the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that were funded by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

Chlorus had a relationship history with the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] at the prison, [[Sadiki Blirr]].
